# Generate, edit, and finish in one timeline.

Moto brings AI generation into a real video timeline - create shots, motion, and audio, then refine everything in one place.

This entire film was made in Moto.

Every shot, motion graphic, edit, effect, and sound was created and finished inside the Moto timeline.

## AI tools give you pieces. You still have to build the video.

Generators create assets, not finished projects. You generate in one tool, edit in another, and rebuild every time something changes. Moto turns iteration into refinement: regenerate a shot, adjust a scene, change the motion, or cut a new version without leaving the timeline.

## Watch Moto turn this reference into editable motion in 30 seconds.

For this example, Moto recreated the reference as editable motion graphics in under 30 seconds. The result remains fully editable in the Moto timeline—a task that would typically take a professional more than half an hour.

## Generate in the project. Refine in the timeline.

Moto's AI tools are not a separate destination. They create, transform, and refine assets inside the same project where you edit.

### Generate onto the timeline. Stacked, layered, editable.

Images, video, and graphics generate as clips and layers in your edit, not in a separate tool. Effects stack on each clip: every effect remains visible, ordered, and independently editable. Change a layer, swap a shot, or regenerate a beat. The rest of your timeline stays in place.

### Prompt to motion. Generate, then edit it live.

Create motion graphics as timeline clips: titles, lower thirds, transitions, kinetic type. The output stays in the project, where you can trim, layer, and refine it like the rest of the edit.

### Edit by talking to your project.

Ask it to translate a title, rewrite text, or prepare a motion prompt. The Assistant works with the project context: timelines, sources, media, and tools, instead of acting like a disconnected chat box.

### Build a character once. Keep her shot after shot.

Reusable visual sources help keep generation consistent across scenes and projects. Use existing images, products, locations, or generated outputs as references when consistency matters.

### Give it a brief. Get an assisted first cut.

Start from a brief, script, or references and get structure to refine: scenes, shots, timing, and a first direction. Producer is a starting point, not a locked result.

Generate with Seedance 2.0, Veo 3.1, Kling, Nano Banana, and more inside Moto.

## Not a generator with a preview window. A timeline editor with AI built in.

If you’ve used a video editor, you already know your way around. Moto is a timeline editor with layers, clips, keyframes, effects, audio, and a render queue, plus AI generation built into the same project. The editor stands on its own.
